## Forms · Submit IT Setup → `n8n_submitItSetup(actor, data, options)`
Real `submitITSetup` (sheet *IT Results*). **Snake_Case keys** exactly as ITSetup.html posts them.
**Required** (r2, verified): `workflowId Email_Created Computer_Assigned Phone_Assigned BOSS_Access` (each Yes|No)
**Optional:** `Email_Username Email_Domain(@team-group.com|@robinsonsolutions.com|@industrialappliedtech.com) Email_Temp_Password Computer_Serial Computer_Model Computer_Type Phone_Carrier Phone_Model Phone_Number Phone_VM_Password Incidents_Access CAA_Access Delivery_App_Access Net_Promoter_Score_Access(Yes|No, default No) IT_Notes`; via `extra`: `Employee_Name requestId formId BOSS_TripReports/BOSS_Grievances("Confirmed")` and dynamic `BOSS_Cmte_<site>` / `BOSS_CostSheet_<job>` = "Confirmed".
Email_Username/Domain/Temp_Password are UI-required regardless of Email_Created; the assigned email is only built when Email_Created = Yes.
**Side effects (first submit for NEW_EMP_/EQUIP_REQ_):** step → "Specialist Forms Needed" + `triggerSpecialists` → creates the **jr_title**, review_306090, WIS, SiteDocs… action items. For CHANGE_ it closes the IT it_setup item. Second submit updates in place, no side effects.
**Access:** real session principal must be IT or Admin (`grp.forms.it`). **Authorization ≠ attribution:** role checks run against the real Execution API session (`efx-bot@team-group.com`); `actor` is recorded for attribution only. Passwords land in IT Results and in n8n execution data — mind *Save execution data*.

### Attribution
Pass `actor` from the calling workflow so Forms records who did it, e.g.
`{{ { id: 'n8n:' + $workflow.name, email: 'efx-bot@team-group.com', display: $workflow.name + ' (n8n)' } }}`
If omitted the Router attributes the call to itself. `idempotencyKey` (optional) makes a retry replay the first result for 10 min.
Errors throw as `EFX <CODE>: message` — attach an error output or error workflow on the calling node.
